_comment: Sonni on the Money Lab self-hosted runtime. Merge into ~/.automaton/automaton.json of a SEPARATE Linux user from Money Lab. Secrets are NOT stored here: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (a dedicated key, in its own Anthropic workspace with a monthly spend limit) and TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN (a separate bot from Money Lab) come from the environment file. Amounts are USD cents. funding.provisionedCents is the monthly inference envelope (about 50 EUR at the owner's rate); the owner adds the next month with /fonds. dailyCents paces it (about 1/30 of the month). The VPS is already paid by Money Lab, so its cost here is 0. Replace ownerChatId. Code denies Money Lab's web-business tools when the trader block is present.

resources.description: VPS shared with Money Lab (paid by Money Lab)
